description: Fetch a dataset as JSON-stat — THIS is how you get actual data/observations. Returns the value[] and status[] arrays plus the dimension objects; observations align to dimension.reference_date (the time axis, ISO dates). extension.series[] lists every series (id + Portuguese label) the dataset contains. Requires both the parent domain_id and the dataset id (from list_datasets). Large datasets can be sizeable. lang defaults to PT.
name: get_dataset
title: Get Dataset
